div.head: II As 22
div.ab: Be ðon ðe oþres mannes man underfehþ. Ne underfó nan man oþres mannes man, butan ðæs leafe ðe he ær folgode.
⁊ ne underfó nan mon oþres monnes mon, buton his leafe þe he ær folgode.
⁊ ne … nan man oðres … man, butan þæs leafe þe he:: folgode.
Ne quis recipiat alterius hominem sine licentia. Et nemo recipiat alterius hominem sine licentia eius cui antea seruiuit.
[Be ðon ðe oþres mannes man underfehþ.] [Ld] ⁊ ne underfó nan mon oþres monnes mon, buton his leafe þe he ær folgode.
And no man shall receive a man who is subject to another, without the permission of him whom he has been serving.
And no one is to receive the man of another man, without the permission of him whom he served before.

(Von dem, der den Untergebenen eines anderen Mannes [als Vasallen] aufnimmt. Ld) Und niemand nehme den Untergebenen eines anderen [zum Vasallen] auf, ohne dessen Erlaubniss, dem dieser früher commendirt war.
(Of him who takes another man's dependant [as his vassal]. Ld) And let no one take another's dependant [as his vassal] without the permission of the one to whom he was previously commended.
